result.title: FToken: Factors as Tokens for Dual-Axis Cross-Sectional Return Prediction
result.summary: On a given trading day, a stock-factor panel describes both how stocks differ across factors and how each factor varies across stocks. Most stock Transformers model relationships among stocks or across time. We introduce FToken, which also models relationships among factors. Its factor branch encodes all stocks' values for one factor as a token, applies self-attention across factors, and maps the result back to one return forecast per stock. A second branch applies attention across stocks in the same panel. A gate combines their forecasts using trailing factor covariance and market volatility. We evaluate both branches on NASDAQ, NYSE, and S&P 500 with the benchmarks' five price features and with 158 factors computed from the same data. On the 158-factor NASDAQ panel, averaging the two forecasts yields an information coefficient (IC) of 0.0421, compared with 0.0392 for the strongest external baseline. The gate raises IC to 0.0443 and gives the highest annualized excess return after costs. The equal-weight ensemble has the higher portfolio information ratio. Both combinations also improve on the strongest external baseline in mean IC on the other two 158-factor panels. On the five-feature NYSE panel, the differences are within the variation across seeds. ```

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FToken，将每个因子在所有股票上的取值编码为一个 token，用因子维自注意力与股票维注意力两支路预测收益，并按因子协方差与市场波动门控融合两路预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于金融面板收益预测的专用架构，双轴注意力与门控融合是通用集成手段，既不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态，也未触及 latent 内容使用、证据筛选或停止决策，缺少可迁移的具体线索。
